body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` and `packages/spec-lint/test/record.test.mjs` manually invoke `mkdtempSync` and guard removals in 10 `try/finally` blocks, and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via `t.after` when passed the test context `t`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter from `test(...)`.
   - Replace `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'spec-lint-readme-'))` with `tmp(t, 'spec-lint-readme-')`.
   - Replace `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'spec-lint-walk-'))` with `tmp(t, 'spec-lint-walk-')`.
   - Replace `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'spec-lint-tracked-'))` with `tmp(t, 'spec-lint-tracked-')`.
   - Remove manual `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
2. In `packages/spec-lint/test/record.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter from `test(...)`.
   - Replace `makeTmp()` calls with `tmp(t, 'spec-lint-record-')`.
   - Remove manual `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete the local `function makeTmp()` helper.
3. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs'` and `'packages/spec-lint/test/record.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
4. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/spec-lint` exits 0 with all 145 tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'finally' packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs packages/spec-lint/test/record.test.mjs` outputs 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs packages/spec-lint/test/record.test.mjs` reports 0, 0.
- AC2 `packages/spec-lint/test/record.test.mjs` does not define a local `makeTmp` helper.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/spec-lint/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/spec-lint` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(spec-lint): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 10 try/finally blocks in spec-lint tests
